spark.observation: 2026-07-08 governance remediation reconstructed BACKLOG.md and FEATURE_INDEX.md, surfacing untriaged runtime debt: issue #54 (clippy -D warnings fails on Linux/macOS in sandbox/unix.rs), PR #47 stale ~7 weeks with overlapping clippy cleanup, backend-capability epic #48-52 unstarted, degraded-mode policy #53 undefined, and FEATURE_INDEX coverage gaps F-38 (sandbox unverified), F-40 (python bindings untested), F-45 (veritas shim untested).
spark.initial_question: How should GG-CORE sequence runtime optimization and security hardening work, and how should remediation progress be reported back into GitHub issues #48-54 and PR #47?
spark.why_now: Operator-directed 2026-07-08 immediately after governance repair. Issue #54 blocks clean cross-platform gates; PR #47 has been mergeable-but-idle since 2026-05-22; a ~50-file uncommitted working tree carries in-flight runtime changes that need a verified base to land on.

affected_actors: multi-tenant inference consumers relying on sandbox isolation
problem_frame.failure_mode: Hardening and performance debt accumulates untriaged: the cross-platform lint gate fails (issue #54), sandbox isolation ships unverified (F-38), a mergeable PR rots (#47), and two runtime surfaces (F-40 python bindings, F-45 veritas shim) have no test binding -- leaving a security-boundary runtime with unverified isolation and no evidenced performance posture.
problem_frame.cost_of_failure: Worst case: sandbox escape in a multi-tenant compute runtime. Ongoing: blocked releases on Linux/macOS, erosion of the FEATURE_INDEX verified surface (44/47), duplicate fix effort across PR #47 and issue #54, and an audit trail that cannot evidence hardening claims.

transformation_statement: GG-CORE maintainers move from an untriaged set of hardening and optimization debts (issues #48-54, PR #47, FEATURE_INDEX gaps F-38/F-40/F-45) to a researched, prioritized, and GitHub-reported remediation program without destabilizing the sealed L3 runtime or expanding scope beyond compute-only C.O.R.E. boundaries.

assumptions.statement: Issue #54 clippy failures (dead code + lints in sandbox/unix.rs) are resolvable without functional sandbox changes.
assumptions.validation_method: cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings on Linux CI after fix; sandbox_test.rs + security_sandbox_escape_test.rs pass unchanged.

assumptions.statement: PR #47 still merges cleanly and its clippy cleanup overlaps issue #54; landing it first reduces duplicate work.
assumptions.validation_method: gh pr view 47 --json mergeable,statusCheckRollup; diff its branch against a candidate #54 fix.

assumptions.statement: Performance work can be baselined on the existing Criterion bench suite (F-47) before the issue #52 harness exists.
assumptions.validation_method: Run core-runtime/benches/ suite to establish baseline; compare against docs/BENCHMARKS.md claims.

assumptions.statement: Reporting remediation as GitHub issue comments (not closures) satisfies the fleet autonomous-lane contract.
assumptions.validation_method: Fleet standing instruction: comment progress/evidence allowed; closing issues reserved for the operator.

non_goals: Shipping new backend adapters (BitNet #51 stays a separate experimental track).
Defining the full Backend Capability Contract (ADR #48 is its own initiative).
General refactoring beyond what lint/hardening fixes require.
limitations: C.O.R.E. constraints: contained, offline, IPC-only, pure compute -- no new I/O surfaces.
Section 4 Razor: functions <=40 lines, files <=250 lines, nesting <=3.
Primary dev environment is Windows; Linux/macOS verification only via CI.
~50-file uncommitted working tree must be settled before hardening changes land.
exclusions: Closing GitHub issues or changing priority labels (reserved for operator).
Adding dependencies from the forbidden list (reqwest, hyper, websockets, fs-traversal).
forbidden_interpretations: Optimization does not license weakening or bypassing security checks for speed.
Hardening does not license new auth/, vault/, synapse/, plugins/, or network/ modules.
Remediation reporting does not mean autonomously closing issues -- comments with evidence only.

options.name: Hardening-first, then optimization
options.summary: Resolve issue #54 + triage PR #47 first to restore a clean cross-platform gate and flip F-38 to verified; then baseline benches and pursue optimization on a verified base; report each step as issue comments.

options.name: Optimization-first
options.summary: Baseline and optimize the inference path immediately; defer sandbox lint debt.
options.rejection_reason: A failing clippy gate on Linux/macOS blocks clean CI evidence for any perf change; optimizing atop an unverified sandbox compounds risk in an L3 runtime.

options.name: Parallel hardening + optimization tracks
options.summary: Run both tracks concurrently in separate branches/worktrees.
options.rejection_reason: The ~50-file uncommitted working tree makes parallel tracks collision-prone; sequencing is required until the tree is committed and PR #47 is triaged.

evidence_required: cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings clean on Linux/macOS CI
Full cargo test suite pass including security_* and sandbox tests
FEATURE_INDEX F-38 flipped to verified with named test binding in same commit
/qor-audit PASS gate artifact before any implementation touching ipc/, sandbox/, security/
GitHub issue comments citing commit/CI evidence, [agent @ GG-CORE] identity, per fleet lane
Criterion baseline vs post-change results for any optimization commit
escalation_triggers: Any diff touching ipc/, sandbox/, or security/ without a prior audit PASS
Reappearance of clippy -D warnings failures after fix
Unexplained >10% regression in any Criterion benchmark
Appearance of forbidden modules or dependencies

failure_remediation.containment_action: Revert the fix commit; log Shadow Genome entry

failure_remediation.detection_signal: Integration test failures or FEATURE_INDEX verified->unverified flip at seal
failure_remediation.containment_action: Revert optimization commit; record bench + test evidence

failure_remediation.detection_signal: New auth/vault/synapse/plugins/network modules or forbidden deps in Cargo.toml
failure_remediation.containment_action: ABORT per CLAUDE.md forbidden-modules rule; strip the change

failure_remediation.detection_signal: Merge conflict or duplicated clippy fix between branch and new work
failure_remediation.containment_action: Halt; escalate rebase/merge decision to operator
